rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when talking about demolishing a building.

example.english: The demolition of this old building is scheduled for next month.
example.traditional: 呢座舊樓下個月就拆樓喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 gau6 lau4 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 caak3 lau2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a named demolition project, especially one involving structures beyond an ordinary building.

example.english: The demolition project for the bridge will officially begin next month.
example.traditional: 條橋嘅拆卸工程下個月正式展開。
example.jyutping: tiu4 kiu4 ge3 caak3 se3 gung1 cing4 haa6 go3 jyut6 zing3 sik1 zin2 hoi1
